snippet.title: THE MAGICIAN VR: THE CURSED WAND - RELEASE WINDOW - The UploadVR Showcase 2026
snippet.description: The Ultimate Spellcasting Experience arrives this September. In The Magician VR: The Cursed Wand, you play as a fallen magician who accidentally unleashes an interdimensional invasion while trying to reclaim his lost glory. Using a mysterious magic Wand, you’ll cast spells with real-world wrist gestures, creating a fast-paced, fluid, and deeply immersive combat system that will make you feel like a true magician. Defend the Art Deco city of Crowville from an otherworldly army across story-driven modes like Incursions, with light strategy and tower defense mechanics, and Nightmare, an endless wave mode for pure magical chaos. With its dark comic book style, original soundtrack and smooth Meta Quest optimization, this is a unique VR fantasy spectacle coming this September to Meta Quest 2 & 3. Wishlist now available.
